verdict.rationale: Cekura is an AI-driven agent testing platform, so it could plausibly let users attach MCP servers as tool sources, and the axis applies. The evidence only covers the opposite role: Cekura publishes its own MCP server and skills plugin so external coding assistants can call Cekura. Nothing shows Cekura itself connecting to user-supplied MCP servers. Its mock tools are auto-fetched from voice providers (VAPI, Retell, ElevenLabs, Bland), not from MCP, which is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.
